description: Checked coverage: under the three causal premises and excluded middle, the target mental kind is eliminative, reductive or nonreductive in the defined senses. Comparator also checks the four-way partition, exclusivity, witnesses of each branch and three deletion models. An account with an unbased occurrence must reject one of the premises, and the deletion models each keep two causal premises; the result establishes neither physicalism nor any premise. No root premise is discharged.
